" + head)` still selects the first line that begins with `# ddflow brief`, not necessarily the single H1 emitted by the view. Given a resume slice that itself contains a standalone `# ddflow brief` line before the real view heading -- for example `"## RESUME
# ddflow brief
recoverable work
# ddflow brief
## Work
"` -- the lead (`undecided`/reports/contest) is inserted after `## RESUME` and before the earlier slice line, so the new-work blocks still appear above recoverable work inside the RESUME section.
